newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MONEY MANAGERS SLIGHTLY MORE DEFENSIVE - SURVEY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MONEY MANAGERS SLIGHTLY MORE DEFENSIVE - SURVEY.

text.p: U.S. money managers were more defensive with their debt portfolios over the past week, but more said their next move would be a "buy," according to an MCM MoneyWatch Inc survey.
Portfolio managers representing 45 percent of total assets in the survey indicated their next likely move would be to buy, up from 40 percent the prior week.
Strategists leaning toward "sell" remained steady at 11 percent.
Forty-four percent of managers said they were "neutral" on the market, down from 49 percent the prior week.
The survey included 38 domestic participants who manage about $110 billion in fixed-income assets. The poll is conducted weekly by MCM and usually is released on Tuesday.
